ideas.pitch: A multilingual local-dialect voice agent that connects rural Indian citizens to primary healthcare advice, vaccination schedules, and government health schemes over plain telephone lines or low-bandwidth web audio.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve India's growing problems by leveraging modern tech stacks, including Web Development, Web3, App dev , SaaS, AI/ML, Blockchain, etc. (Open Innovation)
ideas.title: JanArogya Voice
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the multilingual health assistant design that won the First Prize Hackathon by addressing a massive, highly visible local societal need in India.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight supply chain tracking SaaS for Indian agricultural cooperatives to prevent pesticide overuse and trace crop origins from local farms to urban mandis.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve India's growing problems by leveraging modern tech stacks, including Web Development, Web3, App dev , SaaS, AI/ML, Blockchain, etc. (Open Innovation)
ideas.title: AgriTrace India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a trendy tech stack (SaaS + data pipelines) with a concrete, quantifiable socio-economic benefit for Indian farmers, appealing directly to judges looking for local real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI Android application that uses smartphone cameras and onboard accelerometers to automatically log, tag, and rate road damage severity across Indian municipal wards.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve India's growing problems by leveraging modern tech stacks, including Web Development, Web3, App dev , SaaS, AI/ML, Blockchain, etc. (Open Innovation)
ideas.title: PotholeVision Mobile
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven live camera-plus-ML architecture from the Hack4Soc-winning fitsense project, focusing on urban infrastructure problems highly relatable to Indian evaluators.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency computer vision garbage classification and sorting dashboard tailored for Indian municipal recycling plants to automate dry and wet waste segregation.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve India's growing problems by leveraging modern tech stacks, including Web Development, Web3, App dev , SaaS, AI/ML, Blockchain, etc. (Open Innovation)
ideas.title: CivicRecycle AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the runner-up success pattern of the TechnoMorph garbage classifier by pairing hardware/camera vision simulation with a polished real-time web dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that ingests unstructured local retail and mandi walkthrough footage, making vendor stall inventories instantly searchable for wholesale buyers.
